missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

blocking_reasons: The manuscript reports no experimental results: the evaluation is explicitly in progress and all empirical findings are deferred to future versions, so the central research questions about Skill and memory effects are unverified.
The contribution is a benchmark design and protocol specification rather than a validated benchmark with demonstrated measurements, leaving the claimed value of the suite unestablished.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: No empirical results are reported, so there is no headline gain to corroborate.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic task-specific verifiers using reference values, withheld labels, and artifact checks.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: No model or agent is trained, tuned, or adapted in this manuscript.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Because the manuscript presents only the framework, tasks, and verification protocols, the research questions regarding the quantitative impact of curated versus automatic skill loading and memory interaction remain unaddressed by empirical evidence.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation has not yet been conducted. The authors explicitly note that runs are currently in progress and that results, comparative analyses, and experimental data will be added in future versions.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: No experimental results or empirical evaluation are reported in this version of the paper.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic domain-specific verifiers measuring residuals, diffraction fit parameters, precision-recall, and segmentation overlap.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Not applicable as no models or agents are trained or adapted in the manuscript.

primary.limitations: The current benchmark suite contains only four tasks across two domains, and the manuscript lacks all experimental results, precluding verification of how the proposed protocol performs across models and harnesses.
primary.method_assessment: The benchmark protocol and experimental design are specified in detail, including sandbox resets, deterministic verifiers for continuous scoring, paired task bootstrap confidence intervals, and a failure taxonomy. However, the paper is explicitly released as a design document without presenting the execution or empirical results of the planned factorial runs.
primary.quality_rationale: While the methodology and benchmark specifications are thoroughly articulated, the complete lack of experimental results and evaluation data leaves the primary empirical claims unverified, warranting an uncertain decision under curate standards.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript proposes SkillBuffBench, a benchmark protocol and factorial experimental design intended to measure the contribution of agent Skills across four harnesses, multiple models, three skill conditions, and two memory modes using four expert-contributed tasks in materials science and biology.
